title: Feedback-Calibrated Protein Optimization with Batch-Aligned Tail Arbitration
abstract: arXiv:2609.37808v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Protein optimization aims to discover high-fitness sequences under a limited experimental budget. Existing machine-learning methods use task-specific predictors, biological priors, or ranking-aware objectives to guide which variants are tested in the next experimental round. However, these methods cannot adapt to shifts in the reliability of predictive evidence as measurements accumulate and ensure the correct ranking of key high-fitness candidates. To address these challenges, we propose Batch-Aligned Tail Arbitration (BATA), which uses experimental feedback to adaptively combine prior-informed and task-specific rankings for next-batch selection, with calibration focused on the batch-aligned high-fitness region. Across measured GB1, PABP, and TrpB landscapes, BATA achieves the best mean task rank (1.67) in final best fitness after 480 measurements. translated_title: 基于批次对齐尾部仲裁的反馈校准蛋白质优化
translated_abstract: 蛋白质优化旨在有限的实验预算下发现高适应度序列。现有的机器学习方法使用任务特定预测器、生物学先验或排序感知目标来指导下一轮实验中应测试哪些变体。然而，随着测量数据的不断积累，这些方法无法适应预测证据可靠性的变化，也难以确保关键高适应度候选序列的正确排序。为应对这些挑战，我们提出了批次对齐尾部仲裁，该方法利用实验反馈来自适应地结合先验信息排序与任务特定排序，用于下一批次的选择，并将校准重点放在批次对齐的高适应度区域上。在GB1、PABP和TrpB三个测量适应度景观上，BATA在480次测量后的最终最佳适应度上取得了最佳的平均任务排名（1.67）。对照比较进一步表明，高适应度校准可带来依赖于任务性能增益……
tldr: 提出批次对齐尾部仲裁（BATA）方法，利用实验反馈自适应地融合先验信息与任务特定排序来指导批次选择，在GB1、PABP和TrpB蛋白质优化任务中以最少测量次数取得最佳平均排名。
en_tdlr: Proposes Batch-Aligned Tail Arbitration (BATA), which leverages experimental feedback to adaptively combine prior-informed and task-specific rankings for next-batch selection, achieving the best mean task rank on GB1, PABP, and TrpB protein optimization landscapes.
